body.title: Daemon: team and review methods
body.summary: Add team.refresh {repoPath, branch?}, team.claim and team.release {repoPath, unit}, workflow.reviewArtifact {repoPath, artifactPath} and workflow.resolveFinding {artifactPath, findingId, action, note?}, each returning what the client service returns today and letting a ToolDenied reach the client as an error; register them in the handler contract key-set cases.
acceptanceChecks: each method returns the old result and refusals with claims enforced
handler.test.ts and handler-runtime.test.ts key-set cases list the new methods

tests.name: review-resolve-daemon.test.ts: with claims enforced, reviewArtifact and resolveFinding run through the daemon methods and return the old results and refusals
handler-runtime.test.ts: team.refresh, team.claim and team.release are registered and return the old results
